0.3.2.title: Your phone, paired
0.3.2.summary: Use the assistant on your Android phone: the same conversation, voice and canvas.
0.3.2.prompt: Help me pair my phone. Tell me what I need first, then show the pairing code. Don't change anything else.
0.3.2.expected: A QR code to scan with the phone, and where to get the app.

0.3.2.title: It keeps track of what you have to do
0.3.2.summary: Mention a plan in chat and it's noted, then you're reminded at the right time.
0.3.2.prompt: I'm trying the reminders feature. Pretend I just said: 'I need to call the bank tomorrow at 2pm.' Show me what you would note and when you would remind me, but mark it as a practice item and delete it afterwards.
0.3.2.expected: A 'Noted' card appears, and the practice item can be removed.

0.3.2.title: Finds your free time
0.3.2.summary: Ask when you're free; it checks your appointments and outings.
0.3.2.prompt: When am I free tomorrow between 9am and 9pm for at least an hour? Only look; don't add anything.
0.3.2.expected: A list of free stretches around what you already have.

0.3.2.title: Features that arrive when you need them
0.3.2.summary: Optional features (school, phone control, calendar and more) download only when you need them.
0.3.2.prompt: Show me the optional modules available and explain which might fit what I do. This is a guided feature test: don't install or connect anything until I choose to.
0.3.2.expected: The assistant explains available modules and waits for your choice.

0.3.2.title: A canvas over your work
0.3.2.summary: Ask for a visual explanation or interactive card, then close it when finished.
0.3.2.prompt: I am trying the canvas feature. Show a small temporary interactive card explaining the three steps of planning a day. Do not open or change any of my files. Tell me how to dismiss it and let me confirm whether it appeared.
0.3.2.expected: An interactive card appears and can be dismissed.

0.3.2.title: Memory you can inspect
0.3.2.summary: Choose a harmless practice fact, check what was saved, and remove it afterwards.
0.3.2.prompt: Help me try your memory feature. Explain what you can remember and ask me to choose a harmless practice fact. Save it only after I confirm, show what was saved, and offer to remove that practice memory afterwards.
0.3.2.expected: You choose the fact, can inspect it, and can remove it.
